text: Centralized Governance: PUB's appointment reduces fragmentation and aligns coastal, drainage, and water-supply considerations for whole-of-basin risk management. Legislation and Code of Practice: New legislation and a national Code of Practice standardize design and operations, ensuring effective implementation and lifecycle guidance. Hybrid Solutions: Incorporates nature-based solutions with traditional infrastructure, enhancing multi-functionality and community acceptance. Advanced Modeling: Coastal-Inland Flood Model optimizes interventions across the drainage-coast interface. R&D and Innovation: The Coastal Protection and Flood Management Research Programme (CFRP) accelerates solution development with a dedicated Centre of Excellence.

metadata.solution_name: Appointment of PUB as National Coastal Protection Agency
